scope: Further exact projection optimization before controller work. Short cpp_ring_buffer chat128 release A/B; no repeated pp/depth sweep.
retained: Q5_K batch8/one-tile activation staging uses compact XOR addressing:17KiB including sums versus21KiB. Arithmetic and accumulation order are unchanged; other formats and widths keep their original layout.
IQ4_XS batch8 M17408 K5120 uses two staged tiles with its original padded layout.
BF16 batch8 M12288 or17408 K5120 uses one row per wave, extending the existing DFlash2 attention-output geometry.
The maintained production-template GEMM probe adds Q5_K and IQ4_XS types. No new test binaries or runtime/environment switches.

quality.scope: Final code passes all48 full target-logit rows, rejected-prefix replay/snapshots, and270 draft trace files. Final release checks pass all24 greedy token traces against qualified AR.

microbenchmark_scope: Production-shape probes rotate at least128MiB of weights, with four interleaved rounds. Long probes use96 iterations per round. Every output must be bit-identical to the original geometry before timing counts. Prototype layout variants live outside production.

release.workload: cpp_ring_buffer chat, 128 generated tokens, fixed seven proposals, two interleaved repetitions; timing includes prompt processing. Short development probe, not a full corpus or depth sweep.

baseline.workload: One diagnostic profile per target, Q4_K_M draft, cpp_ring_buffer chat, 128 tokens. TG begins at the first draft embedding; excludes initial prefill and draft injection. Executors are separated by HIP stream. Profile timings are not throughput estimates.

other_rejected: Compact IQ4 two-tile staging, four Q5 rows and relaxed occupancy hints were slower. BF16 compact staging had no useful improvement over the chosen row geometry. Compact batch32 feature injection remained slower than two batch16 chunks.
limits: Two repetitions of one chat prompt per pairing; not a corpus/depth sweep or a capability evaluation.
Final Q4 gains are1.4..2.1%; Q8 varies-0.17..+0.39%, so no material Q8 throughput gain is claimed.
These rates include prompt processing and cannot be added to the earlier pp2048/tg128 depth0 improvements.
Original-target/conversion and MTP qualification, C>1 work, and controller comparison remain separate.
